name: Ring.ofMinimalAxioms
statement: Type u} [Add R] [Mul R] [Neg R] [Zero R] [One R] (add_assoc : ∀ a b c : R, a + b + c = a + (b + c)) (zero_add : ∀ a : R, 0 + a = a) (neg_add_cancel : ∀ a : R, -a + a = 0) (mul_assoc : ∀ a b c : R, a * b * c = a * (b * c)) (one_mul : ∀ a : R, 1 * a = a) (mul_one : ∀ a : R, a * 1 = a) (left_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c) (right_distrib : ∀ a b c : R, (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c) : Ring R
